entities.name: Urami
entities.description: The Oni of Insatiable Hunger who turned to feeding on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kakuriyo
entities.description: Spirit realm whose food Urami disliked.

entities.name: Ogre-magi
entities.description: Group that struck a deal with Urami.

events.summary: Urami struck a deal with ogre-magi for free rein over their lands but never kept his bargain.
events.quote: The oni, though, never fulfilled his end of the bargain

events.summary: The ogres built a gateway and marked it as a tomb to lure people.
events.quote: the ogres marked the gate as a "tomb" and spread rumors of Urami's demise

relations.quote: preferring instead to keep the ogres in perpetual servitude
